Materials legend

Build scope: regulation-scale green field with end zones, yard markings and stylized Chiefs branding; lower seating bowl; CommunityAmerica club/suites; upper deck; press facilities; two scoreboard structures; four corner ramp towers; underground locker rooms and player tunnels. Clear air inside the structure, but do not excavate every air cell outside its footprint. Seats, aisles, tunnels and rooms are Minecraft approximations, not architectural construction documents.

Sources: NFL 2026 field dimensions · Arrowhead official levels/maps · Turner renovation summary. The overall 240 × 288 footprint is a model-design estimate, not a verified stadium measurement.

This is a Minecraft-friendly reconstruction blueprint, not a verified archaeological block-by-block survey. Nothing in this HTML requires a connection or a mod.

Build by Material

Pick one material to see every matching /fill command across all 80 levels, organized by layer and Z row. Expand a layer to work through its commands one at a time.

Copy ≠ placed: Copy pastes one command into your clipboard. Use Mark placed after successfully running the command, or use the Blueprint tab to mark individual blocks placed by hand. All three tabs share the same saved progress. Layer groups load their rows when expanded to keep the site responsive.

Copied ≠ placed: Minecraft cannot tell this website whether a pasted command succeeded. After pasting, click Mark placed beside that command. You can also mark a block, row, or column by hand. Each unique blueprint block is counted only once, even when rows and columns overlap. Air never counts.
